name: TC-430: idempotency replay — the same key twice produces exactly ONE payment row
description: Two settle-cash calls with the SAME idempotencyKey: the first is a genuine leg, the second replays it (replayed:true, same leg id, remaining unchanged) — the owner statistics detail endpoint (the one whose Prisma `include` actually selects `payments` — getOrderFullRaw's own route does NOT) shows exactly one SUCCEEDED payment for this order.
